# Progress Bar

Express a wait time or the duration of a process.
See [Progress Bar guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/progress-bar/design/)

<Canvas of={ProgressbarStories.Basic} />

```css
.w-208 {
  width: 208px;
}
.w-1\/4 {
  width: 25%;
}
.w-full {
  width: 100%;
}
```
